coverage_notes: Covers every stable src/components/ui primitive plus shared customer/admin composites modified by the design-conformance refactor. Routes, one-off page compositions, and unmodified feature-local components are excluded.

components.name: Badge
components.props_summary: Compact semantic label with declared visual variants.

components.name: Button
components.props_summary: Primary action primitive with explicit variant and size; server-rendered links consume the matching button-variants module.

components.name: Card
components.props_summary: Structured surface with header, content, action, and footer slots; CardTitle defaults to h3 and accepts an as prop for the surrounding heading level.

components.name: Dialog
components.props_summary: Modal overlay with title, description, close control, and focus management.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.props_summary: Keyboard-accessible action or selection menu.

components.name: Icon
components.props_summary: Lucide icon wrapper with semantic intent and size variants.

components.name: Input
components.props_summary: Text input with shared field, invalid, and focus treatment.

components.name: Label
components.props_summary: Form label using the shared UI type treatment.

components.name: ScrollArea
components.props_summary: Styled scroll viewport and scrollbar.

components.name: Select
components.props_summary: Keyboard-accessible single-value select and option list.

components.name: Separator
components.props_summary: Semantic horizontal or vertical divider.

components.name: Sheet
components.props_summary: Edge-anchored overlay with focus management and close affordance.

components.name: Skeleton
components.props_summary: Non-interactive loading placeholder.

components.name: Toaster
components.props_summary: Application toast host for concise status and error feedback.

components.name: Stars
components.props_summary: Read-only rating display with accessible label and size variants.

components.name: OpenStatusPill
components.props_summary: Localized opening-state pill with cream and forest surface treatments; state is conveyed by text as well as colour.

components.name: Switch
components.props_summary: Binary setting control with shared checked, focus, and disabled states.

components.name: Table
components.props_summary: Responsive data table with bounded container scrolling and an optional persistent TableHeader for operational datasets.

components.name: Tabs
components.props_summary: Keyboard-accessible tab list, trigger, and panel with density variants.

components.name: Textarea
components.props_summary: Multiline field with shared invalid and focus treatment.

components.name: Header
components.props_summary: Bilingual customer navigation with cart and mobile menu state.

components.name: Footer
components.props_summary: Customer place, hours, contact, navigation, and trust footer.

components.name: AnnouncementBanner
components.props_summary: Locale-specific café announcement with dismiss action.

components.name: StickyOrderBar
components.props_summary: Mobile persisted-cart summary and pickup-order action.

components.name: MenuContent
components.props_summary: Bilingual category filtering, item availability, modifier selection, quantity stepping, and add-to-cart feedback.

components.name: OrderContent
components.props_summary: Persisted cart with undoable removal, quantity controls, pickup-time selection, totals, customer validation, and order submission state.

components.name: AdminSidebar
components.props_summary: Authenticated desktop navigation and mobile operations drawer.

components.name: AdminPageHeader
components.props_summary: Dense operations heading, description, and primary action region.

components.name: OrdersDashboard
components.props_summary: Realtime KDS control tower with FIFO columns, state counts, order age, exception messaging, and terminal history.

components.name: OrdersFilter
components.props_summary: URL-backed date, query, and status filtering with announced pending feedback and route-level recovery.

components.name: OrderCard
components.props_summary: Operational order identity, age, detail, status, and next-action pattern.

components.name: MenuItemForm
components.props_summary: Labelled menu editor with image preview, availability state, modifiers, validation, and pending feedback.

components.name: CategoriesManager
components.props_summary: Bilingual category editing with guarded drafts, explicit discard, save feedback, and confirmed deletion.

components.name: SettingsForm
components.props_summary: Café hours and service settings editor with labelled controls, save state, and recovery messaging.

components.name: OrderStatusPresentation
components.props_summary: Directive-free presentation metadata for order and menu states.
